0701.name: Backdrop color (CGRAM mirror)
0701.kind: word (little endian, low/high pair), palette color 0
desc: Low byte of CGRAM color 0, the backdrop color, in the palette buffer that is DMAed to the PPU each frame.
$0702 is its high byte. The buffer starts here, so $0701 + 2*n is palette color n (see $0703).
Set by level, overworld, title and cutscene loaders; the level-end fade, Bowser lightning flash, dark room
spotlight and fireworks effects rewrite it; the fixed color routine reads it as the BGR555 backdrop.
Values: BGR555 color, e.g. $0000 = black, $7FFF = white.

0702.name: Backdrop color, high byte
desc: High byte of the backdrop color word at $0701 (palette buffer color 0). Only written as a single byte by the
title load, Bowser phase 9 (cleared), the dark room spotlight and the Peach fireworks, which write the
low and high bytes separately from data tables.

0703.name: Palette buffer, color 1 onward
0703.kind: byte table (palette buffer, 2 bytes per color, index X)
desc: The CGRAM mirror continues past the backdrop color: $0703 is the low byte of palette color 1, and the
buffer runs on for the whole 256-color palette. Level palette loaders store rows of colors with STA,X;
the level-end dithered fade and the overworld event tile fade read colors back from it. The title and
overworld iris code also store single bytes here, e.g. $FE.

0783.name: Palette buffer, color 129 onward
desc: Part of the same palette buffer as $0701/$0703 (offset $82 into it, the sprite-palette half). Read with
LDA,X as the source color by the dithered fade used when a level ends (to choose the dither pattern) and by
the overworld event palette fade.

0905.name: Palette upload record header
0905.kind: word (size) plus data, DMA upload record
desc: Start of a record in the VRAM/CGRAM upload buffer: a 16-bit size word, then data at $0907 and later.
The level-end fade stores $01FE here (size $FE bytes of colors starting at color 1); the overworld event
fade stores $0070. It is also read back and rewritten with ,X as the fade progresses.

0907.name: Palette upload data
0907.kind: byte table (upload buffer data, index X)
desc: Data bytes of the upload record whose header is at $0905: the new colors that will be copied to CGRAM.
Written with STA,X by the level-end pose/fade code and the overworld event fade, one color byte at a time,
after computing each new color from the palette buffer at $0703/$0783.

0AF6.name: Object gravity / grid buffer
desc: A multi-use table shared by different modes, so the meaning depends on the caller.
Credits and ending scenes: per-object gravity added to the Y speed ($0B05) each frame (set to 1).
Overworld: a buffer of animated tile bytes copied by the water tile animation, which also rotates it with ROL/ROR.
Mode 7 boss rooms: a copy of the tile layout grid kept at $0AF6+Y, read by the rotated tile check.

0B05.name: Credits object Y speed
0B05.kind: byte table, one per credits object (index X)
desc: Vertical speed of each credits/ending actor, as a signed value in 4.4 fixed point ($F0 = -1 pixel per frame).
Set by the cutscene and credits setup (e.g. $F6 = -10 for a bounce, from DATA_0CA3C2), incremented by the
gravity value in $0AF6 each frame, and added to Y position ($0B41) and subpixel ($0B23) by the movers.
Slots are $0F apart: $0B06 is slot 1.

0B06.name: Credits object 1 Y speed
desc: Y speed of object/actor 1, i.e. slot 1 of the table at $0B05. Set by the cutscene steps (e.g. 8 or $F8 = -8)
and by the credits scene actor setup ($F0 for the hopping character), and read by the hopping character update.

0B14.name: Credits object X speed
0B14.kind: byte table, one per credits object (index X)
desc: Horizontal speed of each credits/ending actor, signed (e.g. $F8 = walk left half a pixel per frame).
Set by cutscene scene steps, eggshell fragment spawning (from DATA_0CA5DA) and falling debris (DATA_0CD396),
and used by the movers to update X position ($0B50). $0B15 is slot 1.

0B23.name: Credits object Y subpixel
0B23.kind: byte table, one per credits object (index X)
desc: Fractional part of each object's Y position: the movers add the Y speed's fractional bits to it with ADC
and carry the overflow into the whole-pixel Y position ($0B41). Cleared (STZ) when objects are initialized.

0B32.name: Credits object X subpixel
0B32.kind: byte table, one per credits object (index X)
desc: Fractional part of each object's X position, counterpart of $0B23. Only written here, cleared with STZ when
credits jumping objects, scene actors and cutscene objects are initialized.

0B41.name: Credits object Y position, low
0B41.kind: byte table, one per credits object (index X or Y)
desc: Low byte of each credits/cutscene object's Y position on screen. Cleared or set when objects are created,
advanced by the Y speed ($0B05) plus carry from $0B23, and copied from the screen scroll in the castle
cutscenes. $0B5F is the high byte. Read by the draw routines (eggs, Yoshis, falling debris).
Slots are $0F apart: $0B42 is slot 1, $0B43 slot 2, $0B44 slot 3.

0B42.name: Credits object 1 Y position, low
desc: Y position (low byte) of object/actor 1. Set to $9F for the hopping character, or $77 in cutscene steps,
and read by the hopping character, landing pose and cutscene draw routines.

0B43.name: Credits object 2 Y position, low
desc: Y position (low byte) of object 2. Set to $77 by the cutscene steps, cleared when a rising sprite is inactive,
and read by the cutscene sprite drawing routines.

0B44.name: Credits object 3 Y position, low
desc: Y position (low byte) of object 3. Cleared by the rising and sideways sprite code when inactive, set by
substate 2 of the ending when the seven actors are released, and read by the eggshell/Yoshi code.

0B50.name: Credits object X position, low
0B50.kind: byte table, one per credits object (index X or Y)
desc: Low byte of each credits/cutscene object's X position. $0B6E is the high byte. Set at scene setup (e.g. $0100
for Mario just off the right edge, $5F/$60 for cutscene objects), changed by the X speed ($0B14), and read
by the egg, Yoshi and falling debris draw routines. Also the start X of the cutscene sprite row.
Slots are $0F apart: $0B51 is slot 1, $0B52 slot 2, $0B53 slot 3.

0B51.name: Credits object 1 X position, low
desc: X position (low byte) of object 1. Set by the cutscene 3 and 7 state code (e.g. $98 start value)
and read by the object drawing.

0B52.name: Credits object 2 X position, low
desc: X position (low byte) of object 2. Set to $80 when the seven ending actors are released, or $90 by the
cutscene steps, and read by the object drawing.

0B53.name: Credits object 3 X position, low
desc: X position (low byte) of object 3. Set by substate 2 of the ending, cleared by the rising and sideways
sprite code when inactive.

0B5F.name: Credits object Y position, high
0B5F.kind: byte table, one per credits object (index X)
desc: High byte of each object's Y position ($0B41 is the low byte). Copied from the Y scroll high byte in the
castle cutscenes, cleared at initialization, and updated with the sign extension and carry when the movers
add the Y speed.

0B6E.name: Credits object X position, high
0B6E.kind: byte table, one per credits object (index X or Y)
desc: High byte of each object's X position ($0B50 is the low byte). Set to 1 for actors starting off the right
edge, cleared at initialization, and read by the eggshell, Yoshi and scene substate code.

0B8C.name: Falling debris active flag
0B8C.kind: flag byte table, one per debris slot (index X or Y)
desc: Per-slot active flag for the falling debris effect in a cutscene. Set when a slot is spawned, tested while
moving it, cleared with STZ when it finishes, and read by the draw routine to skip unused slots.
Values: 0 = slot unused; non-zero = in use.
